title: Normalized affine scalar adjunction and canonical projection arrow
statement:
Let A be a commutative ring, Spec A its affine spectrum [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and X an algebraic space over Spec A [def-trf-algebraic-space], with the size convention [def-weil-size-convention]. Use its specified equivalent small ringed model and module equivalence [def-sfb-space-small-ringed-model], module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and the unbounded derived module category and K-injective resolutions [def-sfb-space-derived-module-calculus] [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. On each actual affine etale chart U, define A -> O_X(U) by the chart structure morphism and the canonical A = Gamma(Spec A,O) identification. These maps commute with restriction. Sheafify to obtain the structural coefficient morphism from the constant A-sheaf. Define F_N = O_X tensor_A N, its maps, and the generators b tensor n by the already recorded scalar realization [lem-sfb-scalar-dual-evaluation-descent], with the recorded coefficient transport [def-sfb-constant-module-coefficient-transport] and sheaf tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product].
Define a normalized ordinary scalar datum to consist of an additive exact functor H:Mod(A)->Mod(O_X), with its objects and maps identified with these F_N and F(g), a monoidal structure whose tensorator sends (b tensor m) tensor (c tensor n) to bc tensor (m tensor n), and an additive G:Mod(O_X)->Mod(A), with its values identified with actual compatible families of chart sections. Evaluation of those families respects addition, maps, and the structural A-action on every chart. Include an adjunction H left adjoint to G whose transpose satisfies g(b tensor n) = b times the section corresponding to n.
Define LH using exact derived factorization [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization], and RGamma as the canonical unbounded right derived functor of G. Retain the canonical localization comparison and the degree-zero comparison LH(N[0]) = F_N[0] as isomorphisms. Use the existing native localization tensor and localization tensorators [lem-sf-ringed-derived-native-tensor], and the existing total tensor [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model] [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] and K-flat predicate [def-pc-kflat-complex]. A normalized derived scalar datum extends the ordinary datum by an adjunction LH left adjoint to RGamma agreeing with localization of the ordinary chain transpose and the right-derived computation map, and a natural pullback tensor comparison LH(M tensor^L N) = LH(M) tensor^L LH(N). Characterize this comparison on pairs of K-flat representatives by the native localization tensorators, the exact-derived localization comparison, and the ordinary monoidal functor's termwise total-tensor comparison. Define the scalar projection arrow RGamma(E) tensor^L N[0] -> RGamma(E tensor^L F_N[0]) as the derived adjunction unit followed by RGamma of that specified tensor comparison, then of the counit tensored with the canonical degree-zero comparison. This is data and a construction, with no assertion that such a datum exists for a given X and no invertibility assertion for the projection arrow.
